mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trainings ( trainer_id, title, description, price, category, `level`, thumbnail_url, total_score, average_rating, trainee_count, approval_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{trainerId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{category}, #{level}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{totalScore}, #{averageRating}, #{traineeCount}, #{approvalStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT trainer_id FROM trainings WHERE training_id = #{trainingId}
